snippet.title: FIRE STATE — The World’s First 3DGS Bodycam FPS | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Turn on your bodycam and enter a new generation of tactical combat.

FIRE STATE is a realistic bodycam-style tactical shooter combining real-time 3DGS rendering, immersive battlefield visuals, and smooth, responsive gunplay.

Compete in classic PvP modes including Team Deathmatch, Zone Control, and Demolition. Every shot, every tactical decision, and every intense firefight is captured through the lens of your bodycam.

Every moment is worth recording.
